s-17-1-correct.alt: A live player for an Illustrative bill, S.99002, School bus contracts, drawn as a tracker of six numbered steps. At the first frame steps 1 to 2 done, step 3 now, steps 4 to 6 not yet, and the words say “Step 3 of 6: Committee vote.” Play moves the bill on: step 3 lands as done, then the ring that marks the step the bill is at now slides to step 4 and draws the line behind it, 560 ms in all. The last frame reads steps 1 to 3 done, step 4 now, steps 5 to 6 not yet, “Step 4 of 6: First chamber.” One button plays and pauses, Reset returns to the first frame and is unavailable there with its reason, and Slow motion plays at one tenth speed. Under the player, the still view draws the first and last frames with their times and words.
s-17-1-correct.notes: Live motion player (data-oa-motion). Land, then slide with its draw, one stagger apart, timed from the tokens at the press. Chapter 11’s marks and words for S.99002, which chapter 11 shows at step 4.

s-17-1-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. Three still frames of a count that rises as the page opens, labeled Illustrative: 0 at 0 ms, 412 at 400 ms and 1,284 comments on the rule at 1,200 ms. A line under them says the number was known before the page drew and the count makes the reader wait 1.2 seconds to read it.
s-17-1-failure.notes: Picture of a fault in still frames: a motion with no state change behind it. Failures are never animated in the guide (D2-xxx).

s-17-10-correct.alt: On Newsprint and on Charcoal: a Housing toggle that is pressed, with the selected check before the word, the word in bold and a 2 px edge, beside Schools with a 1 px edge; Fit width checked the same way beside Full size; a list of three chapters with 17 Motion and states as the current page, on the selected band with a 4 px bar; and a link to the current page, Motion, with a 2 px underline. The band measures 1.41 to 1 against Newsprint and 1.41 against Charcoal, so the bar and the weight carry it.

s-17-10-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. Three controls in one view show the chosen option three ways: Fit to window filled in Charcoal and underlined; Full size in bold, underlined, with a 2 px edge; and a Housing chip with a check, bold words and a 2 px edge.

s-17-11-correct.alt: A download button before and after a size is chosen, on Newsprint and on Charcoal. Before: a dashed edge, its words readable at 5.49 to 1 on Newsprint and 7.26 on Charcoal, and under it “Choose a size to download.” After: the primary button, filled, with the same words.

s-17-11-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. A download button faded to 40 percent on Newsprint, its words at 2.48 to 1, with no line that says why it is unavailable.
s-17-11-failure.notes: Picture of a fault: opacity, 2.48 to 1 on Newsprint, no reason.

s-17-12-correct.alt: A symbol search with no match, on Newsprint and on Charcoal: the label “Search the symbols”, a field holding “parking meter”, and under it a dashed region whose words say “0 of 124 symbols. No symbol matches. Clear the search or the filters to see more.”
s-17-12-correct.notes: D2-1157: the count and the advice in one status line.

s-17-12-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. The same search with “No results.” in small secondary words and a blank space under it, with no edge, no count and no step to take.

s-17-2-correct.alt: The nine motion tokens. Six durations as bars on one scale, the hinge’s 680 ms the longest: fast 120 ms for hover and toggles; standard 200 ms for reveals, panels, a mark that lands and a line that draws on its own; slow 320 ms for a move across a page or a component; stagger 40 ms between siblings; hinge 680 ms and lever 560 ms, each played on request only. A line says each is 0 ms under reduced motion. Then three easing curves, time across and progress up: standard cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), which starts quickly and slows into place; enter cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1), which slows all the way into place; exit cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1), which starts slowly and leaves at speed. Each curve ends at its place without passing it.
s-17-2-correct.notes: Values read from tokens.json; bars drawn as calc(value / 680 * 100%) so the scale holds at every width.

s-17-2-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. A line of CSS, transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), beside the curve it draws, which rises past the dashed line that marks the mark’s place by 10 percent before it falls back. A note says 250 ms is no token and the curve overshoots its place.
s-17-2-failure.notes: Picture of a fault: literal timing and an overshooting easing.

s-17-3-correct.alt: The parts of a motion player, numbered 1 to 7, drawn from the player for loop R1’s first link in Rule 17.4. 1, the stage at its first frame: two nodes, wealth concentration filled and money in politics empty. 2, the Play button, which turns to Pause while the motion runs and to Play again at its end. 3, Reset, unavailable at the first frame with a dashed edge. 4, Slow motion, a check box that plays at one tenth speed. 5, the reason line: “At the first frame, so Reset waits until you press Play.” 6, the status line, which says what the frame shows. 7, the still view: the first and last frames with their times and words, and the steps of the motion in order. A numbered key under the player says the same.
s-17-3-correct.notes: A picture of the player, with no controls and no script: the live player is s-17-4-correct.

s-17-3-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. An Illustrative bill’s tracker drawn in three still frames: at 0 ms as the page opens steps 1 to 2 done, step 3 now, steps 4 to 6 not yet; at 560 ms steps 1 to 3 done, step 4 now, steps 5 to 6 not yet; at 3,000 ms, starting again, steps 1 to 2 done, step 3 now, steps 4 to 6 not yet. Above them, one square button with a play icon and no word, and a note that there is no Pause, no Reset and no still view. A line says the motion starts as the page opens and every 3 seconds after.
s-17-3-failure.notes: Picture of a fault in still frames. The tracker’s marks keep chapter 11’s words in the alt, so the drawing says its steps.

s-17-4-correct.alt: A live player for the first link of loop R1 from our systems atlas, “Wealth and political influence reinforce each other”. At the first frame the node for wealth concentration is filled and the node for money in politics is empty. Play draws the link from the first node to the second over 200 ms, then the arrowhead and the second node land, 440 ms in all, and the status line says “Last frame: wealth concentration raises money in politics.” A check box, Preview reduced motion, sets this player’s motion tokens to 0 ms, so Play draws the last frame at once, as it does for every player when a device asks for reduced motion. A line says what this device asks for, and when it asks for reduced motion the preview is checked and unavailable with its reason. Slow motion plays at one tenth speed. The still view draws the first and last frames with their words and lists the steps of the motion.
s-17-4-correct.notes: Live motion player with a reduced-motion preview: data-preview="reduced" sets the six duration tokens to 0ms on the player, so the script reads 0 exactly as it does under the media query.

s-17-4-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. A line of script, link.animate(frames, { duration: 400, easing: “ease-out” }), over three still frames of loop R1’s first link with reduced motion on: at 0 ms and 200 ms the link is still drawing, and only at 400 ms does it reach the second node. A note says the script carries its own 400 ms and never reads the tokens.
s-17-4-failure.notes: Picture of a fault: a script timing that the reduced motion setting cannot reach.

s-17-5-correct.alt: Three live players, one for each behavior. Slide: a ring around the first of two small nodes moves along a hairline to the second over 320 ms with the standard easing. Draw: a line with one bend extends from a filled node to an empty one over 200 ms with the enter easing. Land: a filled disc arrives over an empty node at 112 percent of its size and settles to its true size over 200 ms with the enter easing. Each has a Play button that pauses, Reset, Slow motion at one tenth speed, a status line, and a still view with its first and last frames and its timing in words.
s-17-5-correct.notes: Three motion players (data-oa-motion each), plain nodes untagged.

s-17-5-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. Five still frames of a disc landing on a node with a bounce: true size at 0 ms, 82 percent at 120 ms, 108 percent at 200 ms, 97 percent at 320 ms and true size at 440 ms. A note says the disc sits at four sizes in under half a second.
s-17-5-failure.notes: Picture of a fault in still frames: bounce easing, which our fifth edition already left out.

s-17-7-correct.alt: An Illustrative bill’s tracker while it loads, on Newsprint and on Charcoal: the title “Bill S.99002, School bus contracts”, a still line where the six steps will sit, with no steps on it, and the words “Loading the tracker for S.99002.” The line measures 4.29 to 1 on Newsprint and 7.26 on Charcoal. Nothing moves.
s-17-7-correct.notes: D2-200: the links alone, never a node, so no mark reads as a step under way.

s-17-7-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. Three still frames of a loading pulse: a disc at 20 percent strength at 0 ms, 50 percent at 600 ms and 20 percent again at 1,200 ms. A note says it fades every 1.2 seconds for as long as the wait lasts and nothing says what is loading.
s-17-7-failure.notes: Picture of a fault in still frames: our fifth edition’s loading pulse (pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite, 20 to 50 percent), drawn in ink for the picture.

s-17-8-correct.alt: The ten states, each drawn on Newsprint and on Charcoal from the same role tokens, with its cue in words. Muted: Loop R2, outside this view, in secondary words in regular weight with an outline dot, under Loop R1 in bold with a filled dot. Disabled: a download button with a dashed edge and readable words, and the line “Choose a size to download.” Hover: a primary button one shade lighter, its label underlined. Focus: the primary button with a 2 px ring 2 px outside it, Verdigris on Newsprint and Newsprint on Charcoal. Loading: a still line where a tracker will sit and “Loading the tracker for S.99002.” Selected: a Housing chip with a check, bold words and a 2 px edge beside a Schools chip with a 1 px edge. Warning: the warning mark, “Warning:” and a 4 px bar in the text’s ink. Error: the error mark, “Error: Enter a ZIP code with five digits.” and a 4 px Pillar Red bar, on the Error Band on Newsprint and on the ground on Charcoal. Empty: a dashed region that says “0 of 124 symbols. No symbol matches. Clear the search or the filters to see more.” Success: the Verdigris success mark and “You’re signed up. We’ll email you on March 1.”
s-17-8-correct.notes: The canonical ten-states plate (round 1 brief, Rule 17.8): data-oa-theme light and dark cells, role names only. Error Band is initial on Charcoal (D2-1160, confirmed here).

s-17-8-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. Four states drawn by color alone on Newsprint: a selected Housing chip that differs from Schools only by its Prussian fill; an error in Pillar Red words, 2.96 to 1, with no mark or “Error:”; a success in Verdigris words, 3.37 to 1, with no mark; and a download button faded to 40 percent, 2.48 to 1, with no reason.
s-17-8-failure.notes: Picture of a fault. Red words at 2.96 and Verdigris at 3.37 fail text contrast on purpose; the red is the error’s one job.

s-17-9-correct.alt: A primary button, a quiet button and a link, each at rest, on hover and with focus, on Newsprint and on Charcoal. On hover the primary button’s fill steps one shade, 1.41 to 1 from its rest, and its label underlines; the quiet button’s edge grows from 1 to 2 px; the link’s underline grows from 1 to 2 px. With focus each takes a 2 px ring 2 px outside it, Verdigris on Newsprint, 3.37 to 1, and Newsprint on Charcoal, 13.29. On Charcoal the ring around the Newsprint button is the same color as its fill, and the 2 px gap of Charcoal between them shows the ring.
s-17-9-correct.notes: Hover and focus drawn as states (classes), not live, so the plate shows all three at once on both surfaces.

s-17-9-failure.alt: Failure case: do not publish. On Newsprint and on Charcoal, a primary button whose focus ring touches it with no gap, and a quiet button whose hover is an inset shadow. On Charcoal the Newsprint ring meets the Newsprint fill, 1.00 to 1, so focus only makes the button 2 px larger; with forced colors on, the inset shadow disappears and hover shows nothing.
s-17-9-failure.notes: Picture of a fault on both surfaces.
